note: County park on the west side of Maple Lake near Mentor. The nightly sites sit in the wooded north and west loops; the lakeside row on the east side is seasonal. Swim beach (no lifeguard), boat launch and leased dock slips. --Claude
summary: County page + site map read: $32.21 electric (stored fees confirmed), extra person over 6 $1.07, holiday 3-night minimum, booked on the county's Park Permits portal; 63 sites = 17 overnight electric + 46 seasonal; 30 A (20 A on G/I/J/L/O); showers + dump confirmed. Waterfront lead: lakeview -> not waterfront recommended (nightly sites behind woods; only seasonal row 29-36 sees the lake). Pin OK. Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (default down): stored lakeview. The county's site map numbers the sites: the 17 nightly electric sites (yellow, lettered A-P plus one) are in the north and west loops; the lake-side row (blue full-hookup sites 25-36, camp host at 35) and 37-46 are the seasonal sites. On imagery (47.6562,-96.1756) the east row 29-34 runs along Maple Lake's west shore behind a continuous band of shore trees (~25-40 m), i.e. a view at best, and those are seasonal sites the county rents by the night only 'depending on availability'. The west loop's lettered sites K-O face a reed-lined bay of the lake across ~50 m of dense woods; no water view confirmed. No nightly site was seen with the lake in view, so lakeview -> not waterfront is recommended; if the reviewer counts the full-hookup row's 'depending on availability' nightly sale, lakeview could stand on sites 29-34 (around 47.6569,-96.1751) with a caveat.

Long-stay tests (local, mostly seasonal in layout): (1) nightly sold - '17 overnight sites with electric' plus seasonal sites by the day 'depending on availability'; (2) nightly price posted ($32.21-42.95); (3) no wording discouraging nightly guests; (4) 17 of 63 sites (27%) are nightly, above 1 in 10; (5) presence: county page, online portal, phone, Google 4.7 from 37. Passes; the entry is a real public campground with a seasonal majority.

Fees: the 'Daily Park Fee $10.74 per vehicle (up to 6 people)' is listed with the camping rates and the rules say 'Vehicles not registered with the office must register and pay the daily fee'; whether a registered camper's own vehicle also pays it is not stated, so it is left in fees.note rather than written as an entrance fee.
Phone 218-289-3985 confirmed (county facility page; Google). The Emergency Action Plan gives 'Office Phone: 218-574-2254' for the park office.
Website https://www.polkcountymn.gov/facilities/facility/details/Polk-County-Park-1 confirmed (Google still links the old http://www.co.polk.mn.us/).
Season not stated by the county; left unset. Golf carts/ATVs may be used to reach trails outside the park (rule 12); a general county campground, not an OHV base.
Pin: stored 47.6562,-96.1756 sits by the shower building in the middle of the loops; Google's pin is 47.65639,-96.17557. No move.

Erskine leads (task B from p3-426): this park is on Maple Lake south of Mentor; it is neither Lake Cameron RV Park (Erskine, ~12 km east) nor Farmer's Union / Union Lake Sarah Campground (Lake Sarah, ~11 km south-east). See the batch report.
